# Beachy Head

Visit Beachy Head cliffs in Eastbourne. The **UK's highest chalk sea cliff** features at the western end of Eastbourne seafront in the South Downs National Park and Seven Sisters Country Park. Visit the lighthouse, Beachy Head Countryside Centre, Beachy Head pub or take a trip on an open-topped bus.

The spectacular cliffs tops of Beachy Head are a must see for all visitors to Eastbourne and the South Downs. Walk up from the western end of Eastbourne seafront at Meads village or cycle from the start of the South Downs Way.

See the sights from an open-topped bus tour, fly a kite, ride the thermals or join the annual challenging [marathon](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/marathon).

Cliff Safety Campaign

We want you to enjoy your visit but also want you to keep safe.

KEEP AWAY FROM THE CLIFF EDGE In an emergency call 999 and ask for the Coastguard

East Sussex County Council, National Trust, South Downs National Park, Sussex Wildlife Trust, HM Coastguard, Eastbourne Borough Council, Lewes District Council, Seaford Town Council and Wealden District Council.

## Things to see at Beachy Head

1. [![Belle Tout Lighthouse at Dusk](https://eu-assets.simpleview-europe.com/eastbourne/imageresizer/?image=%2Fdmsimgs%2FBelle_Tout_Lighthouse_at_Dusk_721278044.jpg&action=FeaturedItemsFullWidthDCGFINAL1x2)](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/things-to-do/belle-tout-lighthouse-p1239901)





[Belle Tout](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/things-to-do/belle-tout-lighthouse-p1239901)



Famous clifftop lighthouse featured in the TV series 'The Lives and Loves of a She Devil'.

2. [![](https://eu-assets.simpleview-europe.com/eastbourne/imageresizer/?image=%2Fdbimgs%2F05959e23-f174-4ace-b003-280213bb3c9d.jpg&action=FeaturedItemsFullWidthDCGFINAL1x2)](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/food-and-drink/beachy-head-pub-p1237961)





[Beachy Head Pub](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/food-and-drink/beachy-head-pub-p1237961)



Large family pub with all day food and restaurant seating offering superb views of the South Downs across to Belle Tout lighthouse. Includes free parking and children's playground.

3. [![Paragliding](https://eu-assets.simpleview-europe.com/eastbourne/imageresizer/?image=%2Fdmsimgs%2F_Pg_32-33_Paragliders45_846891561.jpg&action=FeaturedItemsFullWidthDCGFINAL1x2)](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/things-to-do/airworks-paragliding-p1238291)





[Airworks Paragliding](https://www.visiteastbourne.com/things-to-do/airworks-paragliding-p1238291)



We meet at our paragliding school/shop in Glynde and then head out to the South Downs for a day of paragliding training or a tandem flight.
